SELECT DISTINCT pp.PORTFOLIO_ID AS portfolioId, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME AS portfolioName, pp.VDATE AS vdate, pp.MDATE AS mdate, pci.ACCT_NO AS acctNo, pci.CCY AS ccy, (SELECT NVL(TDY_INTINCEXP,0) from (SELECT psv.TDY_INTINCEXP FROM PTL_SEC_VALUTION psv WHERE psv.CDATE <= to_date(#{tradeDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') AND psv.INV_AIM='999999' AND psv.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodIdOrg,jdbcType=VARCHAR} order by psv.CDATE desc ) where rownum=1 ) object
,ssai.TRADE_PLACE AS tradePlace
FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO pp
INNER JOIN PTL_SEC_ACCT psa ON psa.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO ssai on ssai.SEC_ACCT_ID = psa.ACCT_NO
LEFT JOIN PTL_CAPACCT_INFO pci ON pci.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID
and ssai.TRD_ACCT_ID=pci.ACCT_NO
and pci.ACCT_TYPE = #{capacctType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
WHERE pp.INVEST_YESORNO='Y' AND pp.PORTFOLIO_TYPE='01'
and psa.ACCT_NO = #{secAcctId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND PP.PORTFOLIO_ID != #{portfolioId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND pp.MDATE >=TO_DATE(#{tradeDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') AND pp.VDATE <=TO_DATE(#{tradeDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND (PP.PORTFOLIO_ID in (select PORTFOLIO_ID from PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY where USER_ID = #{userId}) OR PP.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID in (select PORTFOLIO_ID from PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY where USER_ID = #{userId}))
AND (pp.PORTFOLIO_ID LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{search,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') OR pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{search,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%'))

select PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, CDATE cdate, CHECK_STAUTS checkStatus, VALUATION_TABLE_STATUS valuationTableStatus from PTL_PORTFOLIO_VALUATION where PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} order by cdate DESC
